shorts_extract.hook: One syllable ('Tan'), 21 counted fingers, and a 146-year-old MRI twist: how Paul Broca and Louis Victor Leborgne founded modern brain mapping.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Broca (1861/1865): Patient Leborgne ('Tan') & Lelong left inferior frontal localization + left-hemisphere dominance.
shorts_extract.twist: Dronkers et al. (2007 Brain) high-resolution MRI of Tan's preserved 1861 brain revealing deep Superior Longitudinal Fasciculus tract involvement.
